hook: Growing straight up out of dark forest soil, like a sapling that decided to be a sword, is a blade of living dark wood and pale metal. It has no maker's mark and hums when your hand nears the hilt.

blocks.label: What It Is
blocks.body: Growing straight up out of dark forest soil, like a sapling that decided to be a sword, is a blade of living dark wood and pale metal. It has no maker's mark and hums when your hand nears the hilt.

blocks.label: Maker Voice
blocks.body: GOLDSPIRE SAFETY ADVISORY: Wild-grown armaments are uncertified, uninsured, and possibly unionized. Approved blades are available at any authorized vendor.

blocks.label: At The Table
blocks.body: Tier 1 primary weapon. Agility melee, one-handed, d10+1 physical. Ancient Power: mark Stress before a damage roll to add +3 damage.
